Subject: Executive offsite — AV hub & on‑site lead

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again — we landed on Redwood for our executive workshop on 10/20. Before we finalize the SOW, can you confirm who will be the primary on‑site AV point of contact for the exec hub (main room + overflow room) and the proposed telebridge topology? Our external AV vendor (VectorAV) will need network details and a staging window for gear load‑in.

High level ask:
- Primary on‑site contact name/number
- Confirm telebridge (one hub with redundant codec or two independent bridges?)
- Any constraints around VPN/SIP trunking for fallback

I can share a floor plan and attendee list once we lock the lead.

— Allegra
Allegra Nash
Program Manager, Events & Partnerships
Talisman Financial

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T09:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Executive offsite — AV hub & on‑site lead

Allegra — thanks for the note. I’ll be Redwood’s on‑site lead for the event and I’ll coordinate with VectorAV on the tech walk and staging. My mobile is +1 (415) 555‑0198 (will be primary during load‑in).

Initial recommendations for the hub setup:
- Deploy dual codec bridges (primary + hot standby) in the main room. Standby configured for automatic failover (SIP keepalive + LK health checks).
- One dedicated SIP trunk from your carrier into the telebridge with an alternate SIP route via Redwood’s cloud trunking for fast fallback.
- Overflow/secondary room should be configured as an independent bridge endpoint (separate downstream mix) so we can failover seating without tearing down main room.
- Bring two spare hardware codecs and a local NDI capture box in case we need local recording fallback.

I’ve attached the venue staging rider and a preliminary telebridge spec for VectorAV to review. Can VectorAV confirm a 90‑minute tech walkthrough window on 10/14 (AM preferred)?

Signature:
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Events Program Manager
Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555‑0198

Attachments referenced: venue_staging_rider.docx, telebridge_spec.pdf

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Executive offsite — AV hub & on‑site lead

Looping in a couple of quick operational notes from the infra side:
- Recommend we provision 2x cellular failover hotspots (different carriers) for the hub and register them as SIP trunks with low prescedence — instant fallback for the codec if the primary WAN loses egress.
- Reserve an adjacent quiet room as hot standby for the execs (prewired mic + codec) in case we need to move without audience disruption.
- Ben, can you confirm VectorAV’s typical staging power draw? We should reserve two dedicated 20A circuits for the main rack.

If VectorAV can do the 10/14 walkthrough, let’s have them bring a basic test plan (audio loopback, echo tail, SIP failover test).

— Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Site Reliability, Redwood Inference

From: VectorAV Logistics <ops@vectorav.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Allegra Nash <allegra.nash@talismanco.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T14:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Executive offsite — AV hub & on‑site lead — VectorAV avail + checklist

Hi Sofia / Allegra,

VectorAV can do a 10/14 09:00–10:30 tech walk. We will bring:
- 2x hardware codecs (primary + hot spare)
- 1x NDI recorder + local SSD
- 2x boundary mics for the head table + 4x wireless lavs
- 1x SIP gateway for carrier failover testing
- Cable set & rack cases, PDUs for two 20A circuits

We reviewed your telebridge_spec.pdf and site_map.png — the planned dual‑codec topology is good. Notes:
- We prefer the cloud SIP trunk fallback rather than VPN‑based audio over the customer WAN to avoid jitter on the fallback path.
- For recording retention, we’ll hand off the local master MP4 to Redwood (encrypted transfer) and can also stream to your internal RTMP endpoint if needed.

Estimate for tech walk + staging support (non‑negotiable line items):
- Tech walk (2hrs) + staging support (4hrs): $2,100
- Onsite standby (event day): $1,250 flat

Attachments: telebridge_spec.pdf, site_map.png (attached).

— VectorAV Ops
ops@vectorav.com
VectorAV Logistics
